text: Grab earned $1,039 million in revenue from Malaysia in FY2025, up 27% from $816 million in FY2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.89]. This was Grab's largest revenue contributor by country, representing roughly 31% of total group revenue of $3,370 million for the year.
